blockquote.p: Draft release - issued for review. These mappings have not yet been ratified by the CareSets governance process, which is being established alongside this release. They are informative, not normative: they impose no conformance requirement and do not alter the logical models, which are published exactly as released. Coverage is partial and the relationships are indicative, so implementations should not yet rely on them.
